name: Rankai
long_description:
Websites used to be static billboards, passive and waiting to be found.  

RankAI helps startups and agencies grow websites autonomously. It learns from your site, market, competitors, and performance data to identify which pages should exist, creates them in your brand, publishes them directly to your live website, and continuously improves them based on real traffic and conversion — so your website gets discovered, trusted, and converted on by both human and Agents.
